newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Acer Computer US$70 mln FRN upped.
newsitem.headline: Acer Computer US$70 mln FRN upped.

text.p: Acer Holding International's floating rate note issue was increased to US$70 million from US$50 million, bankers said on Friday.
They said the facility has a final maturity of five years with a put and call option in year three or four.
The deal is guaranteed by Acer Computer International
The issue was priced at par to float at 50 basis points over London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, all-in return for top-tier managers is 57 basis points.
Lead managers are Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and IBJ Asia.
Co-lead managers are Asahi Finance HK, Baodao Commercial Bank, HSBC Markets, Mitsui Trust Finance (HK), Nippon Credit Int'l HK, Sakura Finance Asia, Taishin Int'l Bank and Yokohama Asia.
Managers are Central Trust of China, Offshore Banking Branch, Taipei, Fuji International Finance and Die Erste osterreichische Spar-Casse-Bank and Aktiegesellschaft.
